name: backup-before-migrate
description: Dumps your local database before every migration so a bad one is one command away from undo.

keep.title: Backups kept
keep.description: How many backups to keep in .claude/db-backups; older ones are deleted.

compress.title: Compress PostgreSQL dumps
compress.description: Gzip pg_dump output (.sql.gz). MySQL dumps are plain .sql and SQLite backups a copy of the file either way.

requireBackup.title: Require a backup
requireBackup.description: Block a migration whenever no backup could be taken (remote or unknown database, missing dump tool). SKIP_DB_BACKUP=1 is then ignored.

extraPattern.title: Extra migration pattern
extraPattern.description: A regex for more migration commands to back up before (for example: make migrate|./bin/migrate). Empty: only the built-in list.
